tones.PANIC: The whole colony is in a panic ({cause}): people speak in short, scared, urgent lines and think of nothing else.
tones.GRIEF: The colony is in mourning ({cause}): people speak quietly and sadly, remember the dead and what they were like.
tones.JOY: The colony is in high spirits ({cause}): people are cheerful and glad to talk about it.
tones.PRIDE: The colony is proud ({cause}): people speak of it with satisfaction and a little boasting.
tones.RELIEF: The colony breathes again ({cause}): people are relieved, still a little shaken, glad it is over.
tones.CURIOSITY: The colony is curious ({cause}): people wonder about it, guess and ask each other.
tones.WORRY: The colony is uneasy ({cause}): people are wary and keep coming back to it.
tones.GLOOM: The colony is glum ({cause}): people are tired and low, and grumble more than usual.
tones.ANGER: The colony is angry ({cause}): people are bitter and resentful, and say so.
tones.FESTIVE: The colony is celebrating ({cause}): people are merry, joke and wish each other well.

close.PANIC: You are right in the middle of it and frightened for your own.
close.GRIEF: It is your own loss: you grieve deeply and can hardly think of anything else.
close.JOY: It is your own joy: you are happier than anyone.
close.PRIDE: It is your own doing: you are prouder than anyone.
close.RELIEF: It was you in danger: you are more relieved than anyone.
close.CURIOSITY: It is about you: everyone's eyes are on you, and you feel it.
close.WORRY: It concerns you closely: you are more worried than the rest.
close.GLOOM: It is your own trouble: you feel it more than the rest.
close.ANGER: It is your own loss: you are angrier than anyone.
close.FESTIVE: It is your celebration: you are in the best of spirits.
